Of course, battlefields of different races measured in light-years can also withstand the expansion of Seventh Rank and even Eighth Rank Evolvers.

Boom boom boom.

Lin Yuan slightly activated the power of the world and raised his right hand, striking a distant planet from afar.

Boom boom boom.

The immense power, traveling through the vacuum, propagated continuously, with space faintly warping. Soon, a planet millions of kilometers away exploded into countless fragments with a bang, shooting off in all directions.

...

“A casual strike can shatter a star…”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

Although Sixth Rank Evolvers, known as Fallen Star Warriors, could down stars, it would take their full strength and at least several strikes to penetrate a planet.

As for turning a planet into countless fragments, it’s estimated that only a Sixth Rank Peak Evolver could achieve that.

Yet Lin Yuan did it with a casual strike, without even using an understanding of the rules, relying only on the enhancement of the world’s power.

“The power of the world is too abnormal.”

Lin Yuan felt somewhat emotional; the difference between having the power of the world’s enhancement and not having it was stark.

“My inner world is currently only ten li in size. The power of the world it has given rise to is this formidable. If it were to reach the standard of an Eighth Rank Evolver, a hundred li in size, wouldn’t that be…”

Lin Yuan’s expression was full of anticipation.

Of course.

Lin Yuan was also aware.

Even if the inner world grew to a hundred li wide, it would be hard to compete with a true Eighth Rank Evolver.

After all, Eighth Rank Evolvers possess not just an inner world. The understanding of the rules by their physical soul and so on far surpasses that of Seventh Rank Evolvers in every aspect.

“To step into the Eighth Rank, the first requirement is to open up an inner world, which I have already achieved, so there’s no need to worry…”

Lin Yuan disconnected from the virtual world and returned to reality.

Opening up an inner world in advance was immensely beneficial to Lin Yuan,

Combat power was secondary; more importantly—

By observing the operation of the inner world, Lin Yuan could achieve a deeper understanding of the rules.

Although the inner world was far from comparable to the main world universe starry sky, even less to the five worlds that Lin Yuan had previously traveled through.

But it was, after all, a complete world.

No matter how small a mosquito is, it is still alive.

“As for the second point, I need a sufficiently resolute spiritual will to face the ‘Heart Demon Tribulation’ when breaking through to the Eighth Rank…”

Lin Yuan fell into contemplation.

Unlike strength, spiritual will is hard to measure.

Maybe the spiritual will of some ordinary mortals is even stronger than that of Sixth Rank or Seventh Rank Evolvers.

“Take it slow, there’s no rush.” Lin Yuan thought to himself; one method among many evolvers in the main world for strengthening their spiritual will was to live.

Only by living through the long years, surviving thousands or even tens of thousands of years, experiencing various emotions, and witnessing the passing of close friends and loved ones right before one’s eyes, etc.

The spiritual will naturally grows slowly, finally reaching the level needed to withstand the ‘Heart Demon Tribulation’.

“The time and years I’ve spent traveling through other worlds should also be tempering my spiritual will, right?”

Lin Yuan was in a good mood.

…

At the frontier regions of human civilization.

Several terrifying wills penetrated through and descended.

“What’s going on?”

“Wasn’t it said that that Shisan Peak Master’s talents were just stronger than the other Peak Masters? How has he stepped into the Seventh Rank in just a few years? Is this what you call slightly stronger?”

The leading consciousness let out a huge mental fluctuation and roared.

Just spending less than two years to progress from the initial Sixth Rank to stepping into the Seventh Rank, such talent, if allowed to grow for hundreds or thousands of years, then what?

If they had known about Shisan Peak Master’s talent earlier, the several large clans would have tried to eliminate him at all costs, even if it required a great sacrifice.

It’s better to pay the price now.

It’s much better than paying the price on the battlefields against other races in the future.

“I’m not sure either. Who was it that determined Shisan Peak Master’s talent back then? They must be severely punished!”

The second consciousness immediately spoke with a stern tone, as if determined to get to the bottom of it.

“Actually, it’s not even the fault of the subordinates; Shisan Peak Master was too low profile. Except when he was about to break through the Sixth Rank, and began challenging the Fifth Rank Evolvers of various star domains, who knew Shisan Peak Master’s details?”

The third consciousness couldn’t help but interject.

This was indeed the case. Brilliant Evolvers like Wanyang Holy Son had their information widely spread across many star domains.

But what about Shisan Peak Master?

“It’s pointless to talk about this now. What should we do?”

The fourth consciousness sent out mental fluctuations.

“`

“`

“What should we do?”

“What can we do now?”

The first will that roared out spoke somewhat helplessly.

Now that Peak Master Shisan had stepped into the Seventh Rank, trying to kill him with a curse was simply not realistic anymore.

And even if they succeeded in cursing him to death, given the talent disclosed by Peak Master Shisan, it was estimated that a Supreme Being would immediately take action to resurrect him, without even having to wait.

“Indeed.”

“There’s no chance anymore.”

“Peak Master Shisan is too cautious. After stepping into the Sixth Rank, he has always stayed on the Chikun Main Star, never venturing out.”

“Right.”

“If he doesn’t come out, what can we do?”

Several consciousnesses exchanged thoughts constantly, their tones filled with helplessness.

“Perhaps, thousands of years from now, in the battlefields we open up with the Human Race, a second Chikun Star Lord might emerge. By then, who knows how many of our people will die…”

The first consciousness fell silent for a moment.

“A second Chikun Star Lord?”

The rest of the consciousnesses shuddered at the thought.

The Chikun Star Lord, that was a nearly invincible existence among the Eighth Layer Evolvers.

Even in a Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield, the Chikun Star Lord was formidable enough to run rampant; as the bodily incarnation Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, he was unbridled and had devoured countless other Eighth Layer Evolvers of Different Species.

Only the lofty Ninth Rank Alien Race could make the Chikun Star Lord a little wary.

…..

On the Chikun Main Star.

Lin Yuan was about to continue his cultivation.

Just then,

the voice of the smart assistant suddenly rang out.

“Master, the Star Alliance conference is about to convene. Do you wish to participate?”

“The Star Alliance conference?” Lin Yuan was slightly startled.

Information about the Star Alliance conference flashed quickly through his mind.

The Star Alliance conference, also known as the ‘Annan Star Alliance Conference.’

It was a grand event of the Annan Star Alliance, held once every century.

The Annan Star Alliance is a massive alliance made up of hundreds of Star Domains.

With complex internal relationships, the division of interests among many Star Domains could not be resolved in a short time.

Therefore, the Star Alliance conference was established.

The purpose of the Star Alliance conference was to resolve the many internal conflicts within the Annan Star Alliance. As for why the three goddesses did not intervene, they were absolutely just, but there were some issues that could not be resolved by justice alone and could provoke greater hidden dangers instead.

Additionally, the Star Alliance conference also made changes to all policies within the Alliance to better suit the customs of its citizens.

The Chikun Star Domain was one of the powerful Star Domains within the Annan Star Alliance.

Therefore, the smart assistant asked Lin Yuan if he wished to participate in the Star Alliance conference.

Of course,

not just anyone could participate in the Star Alliance conference.

At such a level that related to the decision-making for a Star Domain, one had to be at least a Sixth-Level Citizen to have the qualification and right to intervene.

Not long ago, before Lin Yuan undertook his fifth passage, he had accumulated enough merits to ascend to a Sixth-Level Citizen and casually had his citizen level raised to the sixth level.

Now he had the qualifications to participate in the Star Alliance conference.

A Sixth-Level Citizen merely met the threshold to participate in the Star Alliance conference.

They had the right to vote, whereas Seventh-Level Citizens would automatically become ‘members of parliament’ of the Annan Star Alliance, with real decision-making power.

“The Star Alliance conference?”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment. He was not normally interested in such activities, but if it were not for the immense importance of the Star Alliance conference,

which could determine the situation and status of hundreds of Star Domains and because Lin Yuan had reached the threshold for participation, the smart assistant probably wouldn’t have reminded him specially.

“I understand.”

Lin Yuan nodded, dismissing the smart assistant.

“Should I attend or not?”

Lin Yuan pondered in his heart.

“Forget it.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

No matter how important the Star Alliance conference was, it held no meaning for him.

He would be better off using that time to further understand the rules and perfect the Seventh Rank Chapter of his Martial Path Evolutionary Path.
